## A — Exam authority, Chapter Seven continued, parking rules, hill parking, no-parking places and roundabouts

This dossier serves first-time, never-licensed applicants preparing for the Vermont knowledge test under the standard noncommercial driver license / learner permit (no class letter asserted) path. The issuing authority is the Vermont Department of Motor Vehicles (Agency of Transportation), and the sole source is the pinned current edition of the Vermont Driver's Manual, whose edition year and form number are recorded in the run configuration and whose currency was confirmed on the issuer's site at registration. These two pages state parking distances, the list of places where parking is prohibited, and roundabout rules; they say nothing about the test itself. The safe exam-fact view bound to this run carries the official question count, passing standard, format and time limit as unknown, so this part asserts no value for any of them; where the handbook's licensing chapter states a count or a required number of correct answers, that statement lives only as a cited knowledge fact in the licensing section's part C, never as an official exam field here. Practice scoring follows only the accepted LearningLoop product policy, labelled as product policy. The corpus is one annual handbook edition, so no BlockedProbe is raised, and no time-variable or location-variable fact is carried as stable knowledge in this section.

corpus_stability.reason: The Vermont Driver's Manual is a single pinned edition (Vermont Driver’s Manual 2025; VN-007 07/2024 MTC) revised no more than once a year by the issuer; no faster-changing corpus feeds this section.

verification_debt.claim_text: Official knowledge-test facts for Vermont (question count, passing standard, format, time limit) are not asserted: the bound safe exam-fact view carries all four as unknown pending issuer liveness confirmation; the percentage passing standard and any time limit are not stated on the handbook's licensing pages at all.
